accounts.deliveryExplainer: Kunnafonidon bɛ don waribon kura, baaralen tɛ min na, min donna DeHub la siɲɛ kelen bɛɛ mɔɔ — o donni fɔlɔ de b'an lakali ko ladɛrɛsi ye i ta yɛrɛ ye.
accounts.checkingWallet: O waribon lajɛli bɛ ka kɛ...
accounts.walletOk: O waribon bɛ se ka donni ta.
accounts.payingOn: Sarali bɛ kɛ DHB la {{chain}} kan
accounts.wrongChain: Ka kunnafonidon san, taa Base walima BNB Chain kan Labɛnw kɔnɔ.
accounts.ownListing: Nin ye i yɛrɛ ka feereta ye. A ɲɛnabɔ Feere pɛrɛn kan.
accounts.confirmInWallet: A dafalen kɛ i ka waribon kɔnɔ...
accounts.confirmingOnChain: A bɛ dafalen kɛ sirasira kan...
accounts.assurance: Kunnafonidon tɛ yɛlɛma fo DeHub mana i ka DHB cili kalan ka bɔ sirasira kan. N'a ma se, sarali bɛ sɛbɛn o feereli kan walisa i ka se k'a lajɛ tuguni — i tɛna to jɔlen abada.
accounts.signInToSell: Don walisa k'i ka kunnafonidon bila sugu la.
accounts.priceOk: ≈ ${{usd}}. Sannikɛla bɛ sara i ma tilennen — DeHub tɛ niyɔrɔ si ta.
accounts.saleFinal: Feereli ye laban ye ani a bɛ fɛn bɛɛ ta — i ka tɔgɔ, sɛbɛnw, tugulaw, bolomafara tariku ani taamasiyɛn josɛrɛw. O kɔ, nin waribon bɛ don kunnafonidon kura, lakolon kɔnɔ.
accounts.walletStays: I ka waribon tɛ feere: DHB, taamasiyɛn bilalen wari ani minti fɛn dilannenw bɛ to i ka konnɛgiw fɛ.
accounts.resumeBody: I ka sarali tɛmɛna nka cili ma ban. A lajɛ tuguni — foyi ma tunun.
